editorial.thesis: A trading-and-healthcare city of about 2.5 million. Its retail is heavy on apparel, footwear & jewellery and desserts, sweets & ice cream, and thin on restaurants & fast food and coaching & training — and 31% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 80% of Ahmedabad's. 11.42 chain outlets per lakh residents against 14.34 in Ahmedabad; 36 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Domino's 40, La Pino'z 19, Apollo Pharmacy 18.

The mapped economy leans to malls & department stores. Shares of all mapped places: malls & department stores 1.1% (Ahmedabad 0.6%); desserts & sweets 1.1% (Ahmedabad 0.8%); hotels & stays 2.5% (Ahmedabad 3.7%); offices 14.5% (Ahmedabad 18.7%). Raw counts would mislead because Ahmedabad is mapped more completely (54,281 places against 34,029), so we compare mix, not counts.

Supply and demand are misaligned. 5 zones hold 31% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Yogi Chowk · Bombay Market-Punagam Road alone has about 296,000 residents and 88 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is less concentrated than in Ahmedabad. 46% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Ahmedabad 46%). The largest cores are Vip Road · Dumas Road (3,571 places) and Anand Mahal Road · Rander Road (2,637).

The widest brand gaps against Ahmedabad. Apollo Pharmacy 18 outlets vs 83; Havmor 0 outlets vs 35; Café Coffee Day 15 outlets vs 46. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 10 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Ahmedabad, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Vip Road · Dumas Road and Yogi Chowk · Bombay Market-Punagam Road are the largest zones by residents (383,000 and 296,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 46% of all commercial places, and Vip Road · Dumas Road alone lists 3,571.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Vip Road · Dumas Road holds 96 of the 286 tracked chain outlets, and Anand Mahal Road · Rander Road adds 53.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Vip Road · Dumas Road and Anand Mahal Road · Rander Road lead on education places (362 and 255, with 128 and 99 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Yogi Chowk · Bombay Market-Punagam Road and Ganesh Nagar. The blue cores include Vip Road · Dumas Road.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (54,281 places in Ahmedabad against 34,029 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Ahmedabad; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Ahmedabad, Surat's mapped places over-index on malls & department stores (1.1% vs 0.6%), desserts & sweets (1.1% vs 0.8%), shops & retail (18.1% vs 14.7%) and under-index on hotels & stays (2.5% vs 3.7%), offices (14.5% vs 18.7%), services & crafts (6.2% vs 7.2%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 286 outlets of 36 tracked national brands within 10 km — 11.42 per lakh residents against Ahmedabad's 14.34 (624 outlets of 38 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Ahmedabad are Apollo Pharmacy (18 vs 83); Havmor (0 vs 35); Café Coffee Day (15 vs 46). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Ahmedabad's, so low means thin by Ahmedabad's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 10 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Surat's age mix against Ahmedabad: children (0–14) 24.9% vs 23.9%, 15–24 21.7% vs 19.3%, working age 48.0% vs 48.8%, 60+ 5.4% vs 8.0%. Under-25s are 47% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 3.8% of mapped places against 4.4% in Ahmedabad — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 40 (Ahmedabad 45), La Pino'z 19 (Ahmedabad 20), McDonald's 15 (Ahmedabad 27), Pizza Hut 13 (Ahmedabad 20). No mapped outlet in either city: Biryani By Kilo, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 1.7% of mapped places against 1.8% in Ahmedabad, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 15 (Ahmedabad 46), Starbucks 7 (Ahmedabad 11), Chai Sutta Bar 1 (Ahmedabad 3). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Blue Tokai, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 1.1% of mapped places against 0.8% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 10 (Ahmedabad 13), Naturals 1 (Ahmedabad 1). No mapped outlet in either city: Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.2% of mapped places against 1.2% in Ahmedabad, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 8 (Ahmedabad 28), DMart 4 (Ahmedabad 13), Big Bazaar 1 (Ahmedabad 3), Spencer's 1 (Ahmedabad 2). No mapped outlet in either city: More, Vishal Mega Mart.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 0.8% of mapped places against 0.6% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 18 (Ahmedabad 83). No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 8.9% of mapped places against 5.5% in Ahmedabad — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Bata 13 (Ahmedabad 29), Reliance Trends 12 (Ahmedabad 26), Raymond 11 (Ahmedabad 34), Westside 7 (Ahmedabad 9).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 7.9% of mapped places against 8.1% in Ahmedabad, so the mix is level.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 2.0% of mapped places against 2.3% in Ahmedabad, so the mix is level.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 3.5% of mapped places against 3.8% in Ahmedabad, so the mix is level.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
